capabilities: hide notes behind a set password
extras: Encryption is off by default; the README warns to back up files before enabling it and notes that files are not encrypted when Obsidian closes unless the ribbon icon is used to encrypt on exit. The author solicits donations (coffee) and pull requests.
problem: Obsidian stores notes as plain files with no built-in way to keep private content hidden from other people who use the device.
summary: Password-protection plugin that locks notes or a chosen folder behind a password, with optional AES file encryption and auto-lock on inactivity.
